references.text: Both parties in a lawsuit shall stand before the Lord, before the priests and the judges who are in office at that time.
The priests, the sons of Levi, shall step forward, for the Lord your God has chosen them to serve and to bless in his name, and by their word every dispute and every injury shall be decided.
The priests were given responsibility to distinguish between holy and common, between unclean and clean, and to teach all the statutes to the children of Israel.
The priests shall act as judges in lawsuits and decide according to the Lord's laws and statutes.
Jehoshaphat appointed Levites, priests, and heads of families in Jerusalem to judge matters concerning the Lord and legal disputes.
The lips of a priest should preserve knowledge, and people should seek instruction from his mouth, for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.
The Levites shall teach Jacob your statutes and Israel your law; they shall offer incense before you and burn whole offerings on your altar.
